content.text: Degi, bela Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba nanamalaga, dule-Judíoʼsurmaladgi-aibachamaladi,

content: Amala, na e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba, e-dummaganmala ambikunonimalad, adi, ise-sogar sogega, emarde Bab-Dummad-Moisésʼba-Igar-uksa-gusadba damaloye. Degine, emarde Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba, Igar-uksadba, degi, e-igar-sogsadba nanamaloye.
A-ukinbali, anmar sogsabalid: “Anmar-sisgan dule-yar-baid-baidginedga anmar ukosurye, degine, anmar-masmalaga anmar a-sisgan-ukosurmarbarye.

”Deginbali, dulemar-yar-baid-baidginmalad, obunnoged-ibagi ibmarmar-ukdanikir, igi mas-ukdanidibe, anmar a-ibagi ibmar ese bakosurye. Ibamar-islidikidgi ibmar-ukdanidibe, anmar ese ibmar-bakosurmarye.” Deginbali, anmar sogsabalid: “Birgagugle-irba (7) anmar nainumargi gwen arbaosurmarye. Dule anmargi ibmar-ganikile, bar anmarga muchub ukosurmarye.”
A-ukinbali, anmar sogsamarbalid: “Birga-ilibali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga mani-bipi-uklegoye (4 gramos), adi, a-manigi Bab-Dummadse-goled-negga ibmar-abelesiid bakegar.

”Adi, a-manigi: Bab-Dummadga bane-bane-madu-ukleged bakega, ega ibmar-gwag-ukleged, degine, bane-bane ibmar-durgan-ogumakar-ukleged bakegar. ”Degine, a-manigi obunnoged-ibagi Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ukleged, nii-binidgi ibmar-ukleged, degi, iba-dummagangi ibmar-ukleged, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-islidik-ukleged bakegarbar. Degine, Israel-dulemar-isgusad-eliegala, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklegoed bakega, degi, bela ibmarmar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-ebulemalad, bakegarbar.

”Deginbali, anmarbali dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Levita-dulemar, degi, dule-neggweburginmalad, anmar-gwenad-gwenadganba na wilubdaknai-guarmalad, adi, wisguega doamar-e-gwenadgan-inse, birgagi igar-megisadba Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklegedgi-sapan-ebuleged, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-negse sedagodibeye, adi, Bab-Dummad-Igargi igar-narmakar-maidba, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged-ailagi ogalegegar.”
A-ukinbali, anmar sogsamarbalid: “Birga-irba, anmar-nainugi gebe-ibmar-sanmakmalad, degine, bela sapi-e-san-gebe-sanmakmalad, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-negse sedagoye.

”Deyobbardo, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidba anmar-masmala-gebe-gwalulemaladi Babga-arbaega ukoye, degine, ibmar-durgan anmar Bab-Dummadga ukbaloye. Anmar-moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, sibad-wawaad-mimmi-gebegwalulemaladi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-arbananaimaladse sedmaloye.”

Deginbali, anmar sogmarbalid: “Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-sabolegedse gebe-madubur-imakleged sedmaloye. Bab-Dummadga ibmar-gwag-ukleged, bela sapi-san, vinoʼmar, olivo-gwallumar, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladse sedmaloye. Degine, anmar-nainugi bela ibmar-welegoed anmar Levita-dulemarga sedoye, degine, anmar na neggweburgi-ibmar-welegoed, we-Levita-dulemarga ambegi gwensak (10%) uklegoed. Wemarde na ambegi gwensak-weemaladid.

”Levita-dulemar ibmar-ambegi gwensak (10%) weenadele, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-wargwen Aarón-e-wagwa, eba naoye. Levita-dulemar, ibmar-ambegi gwensak-wesad (10%), anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse sedoed, adi, ibmar-sabolegedgi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi sabogegar.

”Israel-dulemar, degi, Levita-dulemar, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-gwag-uklesadi, vinoʼmar, degine, olivo-gwallu-uklesad, ibmar-sabolemalad-negse sedoed. Degine, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-uklemalad-ebulemalad a-neggi ambikuoed, degi, agine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-arbananaid, degi, dule-yawagak-dakmalad, degi, dule-namakmalad, agi bukwa-gumarmogoed.” Deginbali, anmar sogsabalid: “Anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg anmar gwen iegosurmarye.”
